text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual commits himself to respect the results of the legislative elections.
- Zeroual confirms June 5 as date for the parliamentary poll and pledges a fair and free ballot.
- Algerian officials take part in a conference on investment in the Mediterranean area in London.
- Zeroual vows to respect the people's choice in the June 5 legislative elections.
- Nahda party leadership confirms the movement's participation in the elections.
